Replace the field validator with @model_validator(mode='after') that reads and sets fields on self.

Replace the field validator with @model_validator(mode='after') that reads and sets fields on self.
Replace @root_validator with @model_validator; pre=True becomes mode='before' on a classmethod taking the raw dict, otherwise mode='after' on an instance method returning self.
Replace @root_validator with @model_validator(mode='before') on a classmethod that works on the input dict.

Remove Config.json_encoders; add @field_serializer for the affected fields (or a PlainSerializer in Annotated) that produces the same output, and move other Config keys to model_config = ConfigDict(...).
Remove json_encoders and add a @model_serializer(mode='wrap') that formats datetimes the same way.
Turn the __root__ model into a pydantic.RootModel[...] subclass and use .root instead of .__root__; parse with model_validate.
Replace the __root__ model with a TypeAdapter over the inner type plus a plain helper class.
Replace Model.update_forward_refs() with Model.model_rebuild().

Replace @validator with @field_validator plus @classmethod; pre=True becomes mode='before', each_item=True becomes validating the list items in the function, always=True becomes validate_default=True on the Field.
Move the check into an Annotated type with AfterValidator / BeforeValidator.
Replace @validate_arguments with @validate_call.
Rename removed config keys to their v2 names in model_config = ConfigDict(...) (allow_mutation=False->frozen=True, orm_mode->from_attributes, fields={...alias}->Field(alias=...)).
Replace @validator with @field_validator plus @classmethod, take info: ValidationInfo and read earlier fields from info.data instead of values.
Replace the field validator with @model_validator(mode='after') that reads and sets fields on self.

Replace `__get_validators__` with `__get_pydantic_core_schema__(cls, source_type, handler)` that returns `core_schema.no_info_plain_validator_function(cls.validate)`, importing `core_schema` from `pydantic_core`. This keeps the existing normalization and validation in `validate` while using Pydantic v2’s custom-type schema API.

Replace `__get_validators__` with `__get_pydantic_core_schema__(cls, source_type, handler)` that returns `core_schema.no_info_after_validator_function(cls.validate, core_schema.str_schema())`, importing `core_schema` from `pydantic_core`. This validates/coerces the input as a string before applying the existing postcode normalization and checks.
Rename removed config keys to their v2 names in model_config = ConfigDict(...) (allow_mutation=False->frozen=True, orm_mode->from_attributes, fields={...alias}->Field(alias=...)).
Replace Model.parse_obj(data) with Model.model_validate(data).
Replace Model.parse_obj(data) with Model(**data).
Replace Model.parse_raw(body) with Model.model_validate_json(body).
Replace Model.parse_raw(body) with Model.model_validate(json.loads(body)).
Replace Model.parse_obj(data) with Model.model_validate(data).
Replace Model.parse_obj(data) with Model(**data).
Replace Model.schema() with Model.model_json_schema().
Replace .copy(update=...) with .model_copy(update=...).
Replace .copy(update=...) with Model(**{**obj.model_dump(), **update}).
Replace Model.__fields__ with Model.model_fields; field.required becomes field.is_required(), outer_type_ becomes annotation.
Set model_config = ConfigDict(from_attributes=True) and replace Model.from_orm(obj) with Model.model_validate(obj).
Replace Model.construct(**data) with Model.model_construct(**data).
Replace .dict(...) with .model_dump(...), keeping the same keyword arguments.
Replace .dict() with dict(obj) and filter keys by hand.
Import `Field` from `pydantic` and declare `key: Union[int, str] = Field(union_mode="left_to_right")` so Pydantic tries the `int` branch first and converts numeric strings.
Add a `@field_validator("key", mode="before")` that converts strings matching an integer representation with `int(value)`, leaving non-numeric strings unchanged.
Add `model_config = {"coerce_numbers_to_str": True}` to `Label` so Pydantic v2 converts numeric `sku` inputs to strings.
Add a `@field_validator("sku", mode="before")` to `Label` that converts integer inputs to strings before validation; import `field_validator` from `pydantic`.
In `from_sensor`, pass `units=int(reading)` when constructing `StockLevel`, explicitly truncating the sensor reading before Pydantic validates the integer field.

Import `field_validator` and add a `@field_validator("units", mode="before")` that converts float inputs with `int(value)` and returns other inputs unchanged, so fractional readings are truncated during model validation.
Replace the `parse_obj_as` import and call with `TypeAdapter` from Pydantic: use `TypeAdapter(List[User]).validate_python(rows)` in `load_users`.
Define a Pydantic v2 `RootModel[List[User]]` for the bulk payload and have `load_users` validate `rows` with that model, returning its `.root` value instead of calling `parse_obj_as`.
Replace .json(...) with .model_dump_json(...), keeping by_alias and other keyword arguments.

Replace `ProfilePatch(**raw).__fields_set__` with `ProfilePatch(**raw).model_fields_set` to use Pydantic v2’s non-deprecated field-set API.
Create the model, then return the sorted keys of `model.model_dump(exclude_unset=True)`. This includes explicitly supplied fields even when their value is `None`.
Add a `@field_serializer("started")` to `Shift` that returns `value.isoformat()`. This preserves the `+00:00` UTC offset when `model_dump(mode="json")` serializes the datetime.

Add a wrap-mode `@model_serializer` to `Shift` that calls the handler for the default serialized mapping, then replaces its `started` value with `self.started.isoformat()` before returning it. This emits `+00:00` instead of `Z`.
Add a Pydantic v2 `@field_serializer("price")` on `Quote` that returns `float(value)`, so `model_dump(mode="json")` emits `price` as a JSON number.
